notes.title: Update 1.3: File Navigation and Index Support
notes.notes:
Sorry for the long delay, updates to Unity and the SteamVR plugin broke my existing build, and I only recently found a way to get things working again.  Once I did, I was able to complete several things I had in progress, and add many new things as well.  So, on to the patch notes:

* Added a file navigation system above the active directory bar, letting the user open folders in a directory or navigate to root folders.  The contents can be loaded using the Open button at the top.
* The file navigation window has a scroll bar for when there are too many folders to show at once.
* Added buttons for navigating up one directory, or returning to the previous open directory.
* Added a Favorites panel to the right, where the current directory can be saved for easy access later.  Favorites entries can also be removed.
* Added Index controller support.  The Index controls can be seen by looking in back, pointing at the corresponding button, and pulling the trigger.
* Fixed issue loading files and folders with certain problem characters.
* Updated UI elements with higher-detail graphics.
* Highlighting folders and files with long names will show the complete name.
* Added tooltips to several buttons.

If anyone's still following this, I hope you find the update useful.  In case Steam doesn't automatically update the application, uninstalling and reinstalling it worked for me.

notes.title: Patch 1.2: More Image Viewing Options
notes.notes:
I've been able to significantly expand the number of ways you can view images.  In addition to viewing them one at a time, you can view all the images in a folder arranged as a row or a column, and can immediately switch between these options by selecting the appropriate buttons (aim the controller and pull the trigger) while File Mode is active.

You can also choose whether to keep image sizes relative to each other (so if one image is half as large as another, it will always show up accordingly) or resize the images so that they have either the same width or the same height.  These options can also be changed around in File Mode.

Lastly, I fit in the ability to press a button to move the image or video back to the default position, and also added some buttons while viewing videos to control whether videos will loop or stop when they reach the end.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.1: Gif Support Added
notes.notes:
New update: I've found a way to get Unity to load Gif images, so now whenever you load a gallery containing .gif images, you will be able to view them just like other images, and they will play properly.

The next update should expand the available image-viewing options.
